resources.description: Compares and ranks supplier quotes by price, lead time, warranty, payment terms and mandatory-requirement eligibility.
Evaluates whether a supplier passes mandatory quality requirements and evidence verification using the certified Supplier Quality Expert v1.
Analyzes procurement portfolio risk from supplier spend concentration, critical dependencies, alternatives, geography and category exposure.
Checks a supplier offer against mandatory and optional procurement requirements and returns a compliance decision and score.
Assesses supplier operational and due-diligence risk from delivery, quality, dependency, incident, certification and financial signals.
Assesses whether a company should bid on a tender or RFP by scoring capability, certification, geographic and contract-value fit.
